The '''City Plaza''' was a location on the city of [[Orotoru G'am]], on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].

The [[Orotoru G'am (track)|Orotoru G'am podracing course]] cut through this plaza all the way through the [[Hall of Heroes (Dac)|Hall of Heroes]].
